title: Outcome: Helm 3 durable autonomous development control plane
body: Parent outcome for Brief sections 1-39. Build a clean Helm 3 control plane that proves the complete acceptance run; Map remains fluid within the human Brief.

title: Human build approval and frozen Brief
body: Record explicit approval of this proposed Map, Brief version, fixed requirements, delegated authority and spending limits. No product work dispatches before closure.

title: Freeze Helm 2 behavioural contract and Helm 3 deltas
body: Create the named freeze checklist; classify behavioural versus implementation-specific expectations without accessing predecessor until HANDOFF closes. Trace: 30, 34.0.

title: Durable commands, events, attempts and unknown outcomes
body: Implement planned immutable command records, idempotency/replay, observed results, append-only attempts/events/findings/handoffs and reconciliation entrypoints. Trace: 8, 10, 25.

title: Authority, refusals and autonomy leases
body: Implement bounded leases, expiry, in-flight cancellation/quarantine, reserve protection and correctness/resource/provider refusal classes. Trace: 12, 15, 38.

title: Model registry, pools, quota observations and budget view
body: Expose capability/data-policy facts, distinct pools, unknown states and historical calibration; do not implement deterministic routing. Trace: 13-15.

title: Worktree ownership and containment contract
body: Create isolated writer/reviewer worktrees, durable ownership and reclamation; prove/document boundary beyond edit hooks including shell/subprocess paths. Trace: 18, 16.

title: Pi-native worker vertical slice
body: Prove create worktree, create Pi session, run Sol worker, consume semantic events, produce structured handoff and shutdown. Trace: 16, 17, 19, 20, 34.2.

title: Helm Pi extension and session lifecycle
body: Enforce lease/node/workspace/tool checks in the loop; add steer, pause, resume, fork, context/checkpoint and termination semantics. Trace: 16, 17.

title: Fable Agent SDK and typed Helm tools
body: Build orchestrator process and small deep tool surface for Brief/Map, workers, gates, reviews, leases, economy, log and escalation. Trace: 6, 7, 14.

title: GitHub-backed fluid Map and closure
body: Represent outcomes, dependencies, gates and questions with GitHub authoritative state plus Helm metadata; enforce closure predicate. Trace: 3, 9, 28.

title: Event-driven supervisor, queues and reconciler
body: Implement no-model polling, coalesced Fable wakes, bounded recovery and restart reconciliation across Pi/Git/worktrees/GitHub/CI. Trace: 11, 25, 28.

title: Verification, independent review and repair loop
body: Implement gates, independent-review provenance, evidence handoffs and repair dispatch using Map acceptance. Trace: 21, 22.

title: Exact-evidence preparation and merge
body: Implement exact head SHA, fresh mergeability/CI/approval reads, merge readback and interrupted-integration recovery. Trace: 23, 38.

title: Shared Helm API, CLI and cockpit projections
body: Build equal CLI/web clients over one API: Overview, Map, Needs You, Workers, Models and Log; projections never authorise. Trace: 26, 27.

title: SHA-pinned Helm CLI Milestone 1 handoff and reuse review
body: After explicit Opus handoff, pin source SHA, run approved import review, port behavioural kernel components only and preserve provenance. Trace: 30-31, 34.1.

title: Retire legacy worker execution after Pi proof
body: Disable legacy path by default only after reliable Pi-native operation; retain temporary fallback only as justified. Trace: 31, 34.8.

title: Run full Helm 3 autonomous feature acceptance scenario
body: Execute and preserve evidence for 3 workers, failure, recovery/escalation, independent review, repair, Fable restart, lease expiry/renewal, exact merge and UI/Map agreement. Trace: 35-38.
